about_the_game:
The Ward is a first-person narrative horror game where nothing is as it seems. Explore a world that looks familiar at first glance but reveals grotesque truths the deeper you wander.

Investigate shifting alleys, abandoned corridors, and surreal spaces that twist between the mundane and the nightmarish. Along the way, you’ll encounter unsettling characters—some who offer guidance, others who conceal darker motives.

But beware: the world is not without danger. Certain stealth horror sections put you face-to-face with lurking terrors. Fail to escape, and one of the world’s inhabitants may vanish forever—altering the story and changing who remains to meet you.

Your choices shape how events unfold: who you trust, what paths you take, and how the story ultimately ends. No two playthroughs feel the same.

Key Features

  • Immersive exploration – Navigate detailed environments that change and distort as you progress.

  • Branching narrative – Decisions and interactions with characters lead to multiple outcomes and endings.

  • Tactile interaction – Use a physics-based grabber to move, throw, and manipulate objects in the world.

  • Stealth horror sections – Survive tense labyrinth encounters where failure has lasting consequences.

  • Dynamic inhabitants – Meet unusual characters whose presence—or absence—depends on your actions.

  • Replayability – Discover new story paths, hidden details, and different fates on each run.

Enter The Ward. Once you step inside, it won’t let you go.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U / AMD Ryzen 5 5500 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
